family_partition: reuse abductive-evaluation-v1 graph families and split membership; all temporal and static views stay together
events: time-indexed Boolean variables; observation time must equal event time; availability controls access
evidence_sequence: old signal, duplicate, delayed old cause plus current signal, current-signal retraction and correction
reference: exact enumeration of a supplied eight-variable unrolled state model
decision_horizon: one check of a time-2 variable followed by one action about the time-2 cause; no multi-step planning claim
undefined_policy: only reference status excludes undefined numerical endpoints; wrong abstention, missing and invalid responses retain maximum applicable loss
aggregation: case and equal-weight original graph-family means; snapshots and renderings are paired repeated measures
text_scope: controlled English rendering of exactly the same supplied model and records; not real-world language transfer
